_comment: The app's About & Credits page. Hand-edited: add a source here when its words, recordings or scores come into the catalog. Each section has a title, an optional intro and its entries (name, what they gave, an optional link).
about: Coptic Chanter is offered by the Coptic Orthodox Churches of Chicagoland and the Midwest, to help everyone learn and follow the hymns of the Church by ear and by eye: hearing the cantors while following the words, and the notes, as they are sung. It is free.

sections.title: Music scores
sections.intro: Coptic hymns have been handed down by ear, from cantor to cantor, for many centuries. We are grateful to those who have given years to writing them in musical notation, so that they can be learned, kept and sung faithfully from one generation, and one church, to the next.
